# `valueConfigs`: the dropdown member lists

Part of [generated data](../generated-data.md). `makeValueConfigs` must keep its `const` type parameter (the rule: [`src/01_SpreadsheetSchema/AGENTS.md`](../../src/01_SpreadsheetSchema/AGENTS.md)).

## How `valueConfigs` is generated

**`valueConfigs`** (`generated/valueConfigs.ts`) — generated by `ValueConfigOperator` (`05_Operators`) from the live "Value Config" sheet, once `columnConfigs` is already synced. After Column Config sync it still catalogs only distinct non-framework value titles in use, as Value Config headers; it asks Column Config for that title list, which walks identity rows (Sheet GID, Column ID) and reads each described column's live value title. **`makeValueConfigs` takes a `const` type parameter, and must keep it** (#18): without it the generated member lists infer as `string[]` and every dropdown column's value type collapses to bare `string`, which silently removes the union a switch over a Value Config's members is meant to be exhaustive against. The generated file carries no `as const` of its own, so the constructor is the only thing holding the literals. Measured at ~41k instantiations — see [type-check cost](../architecture/type-check-cost.md).
